overview: This House resolution sets the default times the House meets each day for the new session. Unless the House decides otherwise, it will convene at 2 p.m. on Mondays, at noon on Tuesdays (or 2 p.m. if no legislative business was done the Monday before), at noon on Wednesdays and Thursdays, and at 9 a.m. on other days. It is a routine resolution adopted at the start of each session. The House agreed to it on January 6, 2026.
for: Supporters say a set schedule helps members, staff and the public know when the House will be in session.
against: Critics say it is a procedural housekeeping measure that doesn't change any law or spending.
